bias_model: bias(d) = c * d^2, subtracted from every measurement (d = distance to marker, m)
sigma_model: sigma(d) = a + b * d^2  (after bias correction)
note: angle errors > 15 deg are the planar-marker pose ambiguity (IPPE flip); the EKF rejects them with a chi-square gate instead of inflating R for every measurement
